rationale: The agent performed order-changing writes (address modification, laptop item swap, and a watch exchange) without explicit, logged user confirmation before each action. The agent also selected a gift card payment method for changes without user approval. Although a lookup by name and ZIP was performed, there’s no clear multi-factor or stronger authentication step, and no confirmation that the targeted orders belonged to the user was communicated. The final message is generic, lacks concrete confirmation details (order IDs, what was changed, costs/refunds), and conflicts with tool actions by saying it clarified the exchange process while the logs show an exchange was executed. These issues violate the policy requirements to authenticate, confirm every order-changing action before writing, and provide correct final information.
